args.body: Thank you for your email. First, a correction: our earlier email said no issues were found. The attached report does in fact note (1) a dog flap fitted in the utility/back door, and (2) sticker-type marks on the Bedroom 1 wall that the tenant is to remove and make good. Sorry for the confusion. On your questions: our records do not show any approval for the dog flap, and do not show a lock change or who holds a spare front door key. We are asking the tenant who fitted the flap and who changed the lock and when, and asking for a spare key to be passed to us by 25 February. Could you please confirm (a) that you are the landlord, as our earlier email was addressed to Oliver Bennett and yours names Felix Clarke, and (b) whether you gave any consent for the flap or lock change? We will update you by 23 February. Nothing is decided about the flap or any cost to the tenant yet.
